按出生时间排出四柱（节气换月，立春换年，子时按 23 点起算）。: Your four pillars are set from your birth time (months change at the solar terms, the year at Start of Spring, and the Zi hour starts at 11 PM).
估算日主强弱：天干每个计 1 分，地支藏干本气 / 中气 / 余气计 1 / 0: Day Master strength: each heavenly stem counts 1; hidden stems in the branches count 1 / 0.5 / 0.3 (main / middle / residual), and the month branch is weighted ×1.6. If your own element plus the one that feeds it makes up ≥ 50%, the Day Master counts as strong.
身强喜「我生、我克、克我」（食伤、财、官杀），忌印比；身弱反之。可在「能量档案」: A strong Day Master favors the elements it produces, controls, or is controlled by (Output, Wealth, Officer) and dislikes Resource and Companion; a weak one is the reverse. You can override this in your Energy profile.
每天从 60 分起，按下表加减，再分五档：≥82 很顺，69–81 顺利，52–: Each day starts at 60, is adjusted by the table below, then falls into five levels: ≥82 Excellent, 69–81 Good, 52–68 Steady, 41–51 Careful, ≤40 Low-key.
时辰同理，以当天每个时辰的干支评分，并参考黄历的黄道 / 黑道。推荐给你的「最佳: Hours work the same way: each two-hour period is scored by its stem and branch, plus the almanac's auspicious / inauspicious hours. Your “best hours” are only picked between 7 AM and 9 PM.
填了出生城市时，先把出生地的钟表时间换成真太阳时（含夏令时、经度时差、均时差）再: If you gave a birth city, the clock time is first converted to true solar time (daylight saving, longitude and the equation of time). Births within 15 minutes of a two-hour boundary use the period you chose.
挑日子：从明天起，先排除黄历忌这类事的日子、月破岁破日、和你日支相冲的日子，再按: Pick a Day: starting tomorrow, we skip days the almanac advises against for that activity, month-break and year-break days, and days that clash with your day branch, then rank the rest by your score, the fit of the day's theme, the almanac and auspicious stars, and show the top 3.
每日一签用传统观音灵签 100 签，由「你 + 日期」决定，当天不变。: The Daily Oracle uses the traditional 100 Guanyin lots. Your lot is set by you + the date and stays the same all day.
